summary: AMASS visual-reskin hand-polish verification (frontend only, mobile 390x844 web preview, logged in as demo@amass.africa / amass2026). Covered all four pillars from the review-request: SHOP, AGENT, FIXA, ADMIN. Every spec'd testID rendered and the ink/soft-grey/premium-gradient language ships without red screens. SHOP: /shop/store/fouani renders shop-store-screen + shop-store-search + both shop-fulfil-pickup & shop-fulfil-showroom (toggle flips active state), shop-store-info opens an info sheet (Locations/Hours), shop-store-sort / shop-store-save / shop-store-route-website all present. shop-add-{id} swaps to shop-stepper-{id} with shop-plus-/shop-minus-, floating shop-basket-pill appears (ink). shop-store-route-website opens shop-handoff-sheet with shop-handoff-cancel (closes). /shop/product/[id]: shop-product-retailer, shop-product-back, shop-product-save, shop-product-add-to-list, shop-product-go-basket all present (shop-product-add correctly swaps to the stepper after add — item in basket shows '1 in your Fouani basket' + Basket pill). /shop/basket: shop-basket-screen, shop-basket-group-fouani, shop-basket-subtotal-fouani, shop-basket-clear-fouani → shop-basket-clear-sheet opens with shop-basket-clear-confirm. shop-basket-route-fouani-website present. /shop/stores: 7 shop-retailer-row-* rows. /shop/search renders category chips + shop-search-all-stores. AGENT: /agent-dashboard portfolio-hero + 3 dash-tabs + quick-new-listing (ink card) + agent-tasks-entry + agent-quota-card. Listings tab: boost-{id} opens boost-sheet with ink boost-tier-promote/feature/boost and gradient boost-submit (not confirmed). Leads tab: open-crm-cta present. /agent-workspace, /agent-score (33/100 Registered Agent ring + factor cards), /agent-plans (serif lowercase hero), /agent/tasks (verification tasks + territory chip), /agent/territory all render. FIXA: /fixa renders fixa-screen + fixa-search + fixa-chip-verified + fixa-balance-pill (590 FIX pill). Tapping fixa-row-* opens detail: fixa-contact-locked ink card + fixa-unlock-cta (gradient) opens unlock-dialog with unlock-cancel (closes without confirm). /provider-dashboard: fix-hero (ink, 579 FIX), boost-btn (gradient), quick-earn + quick-boost render; booking row rendered (sample booking already 'completed' so no complete-{id} to tap — expected). ADMIN: /admin cockpit renders 3 stat tiles (Properties/Listings/Merged) + all 9 nav tiles (dup-queue, rep-queue, neighbours, chat-reports, market-reports, audit, discovery, settings, pricing). EACH tile navigates to a rendering screen (no red screens, no 'Unmatched Route'). /admin/duplicate-queue shows 43 candidates with AMASS-LAG-* refs and Compare / Clear / View-passport actions. Overall: 0 pageerrors, only 2 benign console errors (a 403 analytics request + 1 ERR_INVALID_URL). Deprecation warnings from react-native-web ('shadow*', 'pointerEvents') are RN-web platform noise, not app bugs. Fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans + DM Serif Display) load.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec says tapping a candidate should land on a 'duplicate-review' screen with an ink Merge button. In the current UI the queue item exposes Compare / Clear / View passport inline, and a dedicated Merge button is not visible on the queue or on tap. Could not confirm the ink Merge CTA for this iteration — likely behind Compare. Main agent to confirm the intended route and add a stable testID (e.g. duplicate-merge-{id}).

login-email / login-password / login-submit testIDs timed out on first paint (30s). Fallback via placeholder inputs + text 'sign in' succeeded. Likely a late-mount or font-load timing issue, not a functional bug (iteration_55 confirmed these testIDs exist). Recommend ensuring testIDs render before the font/animation gating resolves.

issues: Seed booking resolves to 'completed' on first load, so the complete-{id} / complete-sheet path cannot be exercised in a fresh session. Non-blocking — testIDs are wired in source.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' logged on every bundle. Reference: /app/frontend (various StyleSheet.create callsites). Non-blocking but should be swept once.

action_items: Clarify duplicate-review flow: either expose a stable 'duplicate-merge-{id}' testID on the ink Merge CTA, or correct the review-request spec to match the Compare / Clear / View-passport buttons that currently ship on /admin/duplicate-queue.
Investigate why login-email / login-password / login-submit testIDs do not resolve within 30s on cold navigation (works on retry / after font load). Likely a mount-order issue on /login.
Sweep StyleSheet.create callsites to migrate 'shadow*' props → boxShadow and 'props.pointerEvents' → style.pointerEvents to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/shop/product/[id].tsx — shop-product-add testID is intentionally replaced by shop-product-go-basket + sticky stepper once the item is in the basket. This is correct but means a UI test cannot assert both testIDs on the same visit; main agent should document this in the spec.

/app/frontend/app/provider-dashboard.tsx — complete-{id} / complete-sheet only renders for bookings whose status != 'completed'. Seed data starts with a completed booking, which prevents coverage of the serif complete-sheet in a one-shot test. Consider seeding at least one in-progress booking.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% — every pillar in the review-request rendered interactively; 1 minor path (duplicate-review Merge) and 1 timing nit (login testIDs) remain open.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login via demo@amass.africa / amass2026. Shop happy path: /shop/store/fouani → tap any [data-testid^='shop-add-'] (becomes shop-stepper-{id} + shop-basket-pill), tap a [data-testid^='shop-product-'] tile to open product, go to /shop/basket. Agent boost sheet is reached from /agent-dashboard → dash-tab-listings → boost-{id}. FIXA unlock dialog: /fixa → fixa-row-* → fixa-unlock-cta → unlock-dialog (unlock-cancel to close). Admin tiles all navigate; duplicate-queue uses AMASS-LAG-* candidate blocks with Compare / Clear / View-passport inline actions (no dedicated Merge testID observed).
rca_of_issue: N/A — pure visual/UX reskin verification, no functional regressions found.
